spans.s: Ketaka, pl., n. of a people or region: Māy 〔96〕.
kettaka, adj. (cf. s.v. ettaka; cf. Pali kittaka, Pkt. kettia), how much?: kettakasya … kālasya Mv 〔i.50.14〕; 〔51.11〕; kettakaṃ (one ms. kevattakaṃ, q.v.) puṇyaṃ 〔80.5〕. (All prose).
ketukā, sc. lipi, a kind of writing: Mv 〔i.135.8〕.
Ketudhvaja, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔iii.230.7 f.〕
Ketuprabhā, n. of a female lay-disciple: Gv 〔51.16〕.
Ketumatī, n. of the capital of the future Buddha Maitreya: Mv 〔iii.240.12〕; cf. Pali Ketumatī, given as a future name for Benares and the birthplace of Metteyya.
Ketumant, n. of a mountain: Dbh 〔96.4〕.
Ketuśrī, n. of a Bodhisattva: Gv 〔4.4〕.
Ketūttama, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔iii.237.7 f.〕
